profile.summary: Emami Paper Mills Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of paper and paper board products in India. It offers packaging boards; and newsprint, writing, and printing papers, kraft papers, paperboards, as well as specialty papers. The company serves business-to-business customers consisting of packaging converters and processors, food and pharmaceutical product companies, publishers, education
